id.description: Unique identifier of the media object

admin_graphql_api_id.description: Unique identifier of the media object in the Admin GraphQL API

product_id.description: Unique identifier of the product the media is attached to

media_type.description: GraphQL typename of the media object: MediaImage, Video, ExternalVideo or Model3d

media_content_type.description: Shopify media content type, e.g. IMAGE, VIDEO, EXTERNAL_VIDEO, MODEL_3D

status.description: Processing status of the media object

alt.description: Alternative text description of the media for accessibility

preview_image_url.description: URL of the media preview image

preview_image_width.description: Width of the media preview image in pixels

preview_image_height.description: Height of the media preview image in pixels

image_url.description: URL of the original image, populated for MediaImage only

image_width.description: Width of the original image in pixels, populated for MediaImage only

image_height.description: Height of the original image in pixels, populated for MediaImage only

mime_type.description: MIME type of the image file, populated for MediaImage only

origin_url.description: Source URL of the hosted video, populated for ExternalVideo only

created_at.description: Date and time when the media was created

updated_at.description: Date and time when the media was last updated

shop_url.description: URL of the shop the media belongs to
